_comment: Historical requirement classifications and source citations, retained alongside WAIVERS.md. This file does not alter the TCK verdict. Obsolete numeric scoring and waiver-ledger gates were removed under KICKOFF; actual suite assertions, failures and exit status remain in force. The recorded waived/skipped/not_applicable premises describe historical reasons, not a current PASS or an executable exception.

waived.why: busbar refuses a plaintext push callback, and the pinned TCK's webhook receiver is http:// by literal (WAIVERS.md, PUSH-DELIVER, blocker 1).

not_applicable.why: Extended-card-not-configured error: the test skips when the card declares extendedAgentCard and the extended card is returned successfully, which CARD-EXT-001 passing on the same run proves (WAIVERS.md, NOT APPLICABLE).
not_applicable.citation: A2A specification v1.0.1 3.3.4: 'If the agent declares support but has not configured an extended card, it MUST return ExtendedAgentCardNotConfiguredError'. pinned TCK 5996b79f9cefa6fc390980e383e358a66fb9e49e tests/compatibility/core_operations/test_error_handling.py:386-428 (TestExtendedCardNotConfigured: 'can only pass or skip', skips when the extended card is returned). busbar serves an extended card whenever the deployment fronts an agent, which the subject rig always does: this repository: plane-a2a/src/task_door.rs::extended_card (answers ExtendedAgentCardNotConfigured only for a deployment fronting no agents) and plane-a2a/src/served_card.rs::extended_card_document.

not_applicable.why: Push-not-supported error: the test skips when the card declares pushNotifications, which busbar's served card does (WAIVERS.md, NOT APPLICABLE).
not_applicable.citation: A2A specification v1.0.1 (a2aproject/A2A @ v1.0.1, docs/specification.md) 3.3.4 Capability Validation: 'Agents declare optional capabilities in their AgentCard'; each MUST there binds an agent that does NOT declare the capability. pinned TCK 5996b79f9cefa6fc390980e383e358a66fb9e49e tests/compatibility/core_operations/test_error_handling.py:211-226 (TestCapabilityPushNotifications: `if caps.get("pushNotifications"): ... skip('Agent supports push notifications')`). busbar always serves this capability: this repository: plane-a2a/src/served_card.rs::self_card_document writes capabilities {streaming, pushNotifications, extendedAgentCard} true on busbar's own card, and no busbar configuration turns one off.

not_applicable.why: Required-extension-missing error: the test runs only against an agent card that declares urn:a2a:tck:required-extension as REQUIRED. Extensions are optional in A2A, busbar implements none, and so it declares none; there is no busbar behaviour for this MUST to verify (WAIVERS.md, NOT APPLICABLE).
not_applicable.citation: A2A specification v1.0.1 4.6 Extensions: extensions provide functionality 'beyond the core specification'; 3.3.4 binds only an agent whose card marks an extension required: true. pinned TCK 5996b79f9cefa6fc390980e383e358a66fb9e49e tests/compatibility/core_operations/test_error_handling.py:296-321 (TestCapabilityExtensionRequired: skips unless the card declares urn:a2a:tck:required-extension as required). busbar implements no A2A extension and its own card declares none: this repository: plane-a2a/src/served_card.rs::self_card_document (has no extensions member).
